meta.title: Select all lines on a page

steps.note: Open the Purchase Requisitions area as the buyer.
Ensure the PR list is on the Open tab, where sourcing is permitted.

args.goal: On the Open Purchase Requisitions page, tick the header checkbox, verify every line on the current page is selected, and verify that Purchase Items applies the applicable service/material, BOQ, locked-line, and rejected-line mix rules with the matching product message or enabled state shown on screen.

steps.note: Exercise the page-level select-all control and observe the resulting Purchase Items rule handling, which no narrower catalog step exposes.
Confirm the Purchase Items control is present after the selection.
